QUOTE: The default `mbedtls_config.h` has `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` commented out (line 208), so a stock build calls libc directly.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that with MEMORY off (the default), `platform.h:166-167` maps `mbedtls_calloc` and `mbedtls_free` to libc `calloc` and `free`, so a stock build has no indirection. It doesn't use the word "macro" for this case, but the mechanism and location are named.
